_comment: DDI-CDI -> CDIF Data Structure profile UML. Source: metadataBuildingBlocks/_sources/profiles/cdifCompositeProfile/DataDescriptionWithStructure/CDIFDataStructureProfileSchema.json. This is the most DDI-CDI-aligned profile: the JSON schema essentially exposes DDI-CDI's DataStructure / Component / RepresentedVariable / ValueDomain hierarchy. Strategy: heavy use of mappingType=map (with class rename when needed) and association renames - the same pattern as the existing DDSC example (ddi-cdi2ddsc_mapping.json). Target class names follow the JSON schema vocabulary (cdi:DataStructure, cdi:WideDataStructure, cdi:IdentifierComponent, etc.) which happen to match DDI-CDI's class names directly. The cdi:isStructuredBy hook from Distribution -> DataStructure is the key Distribution-level addition and is represented as a new association.

transformation.description: DDI-CDI to CDIF Data Structure Profile

targetModel.modelTitle: UML Model for the CDIF Data Structure Profile
targetModel.subTitle: Full DDI-CDI structural complexity for tabular, long, and dimensional datasets
targetModel.definition: CDIF Data Structure profile - extends Data Description with the full DDI-CDI structural complexity. Distributions carry cdi:isStructuredBy pointing at a Data Structure node. Conforms-to: https://w3id.org/cdif/data_structure/1.0.
targetModel.mainPackageDefinition: Data Structure profile: DataStructure subclasses, Components, RepresentedVariable, ValueDomain.

package.name: DataStructures
package.definition: DataStructure umbrella class and its Dimensional/Long/Wide subclasses.

package.name: Components
package.definition: DataStructureComponent subclasses: Identifier, Measure, Attribute, Dimension, VariableValue, VariableDescriptor; ComponentPosition; PrimaryKey.

package.name: Variables
package.definition: RepresentedVariable, DescriptorVariable plus reuse of InstanceVariable from Data Description. (DDI-CDI ReferenceVariable collapses to RepresentedVariable in CDIF.)

package.name: Physical
package.definition: PhysicalDataSet and its subtypes (TabularTextDataSet, StructuredDataSet) - the byte-level realization a distribution is structured by.

class._comment: Concrete variants generalize the generic DataStructure so the distribution's cdi:isStructuredBy (which targets DataStructure) propagates to them in the diagram.
Abstract supertype of the component types (cdi:DataStructureComponent). Target of the generic DataStructure_has_DataStructureComponent; the concrete components generalize it.

VariableDescriptorComponent is the descriptor (parameter-name) column of a long-format data structure. Unlike the other components it is defined by a DescriptorVariable (not a RepresentedVariable), so it is modelled standalone rather than generalizing the abstract DataStructureComponent (which carries isDefinedBy_RepresentedVariable). It keeps its own identifier/semantic/refersTo via the source map.

DescriptorVariable - in the CDIF profile a descriptor variable carries only an identifier, a name, and the DescriptorValueDomain enumerating the codes it can take (cdif:hasValuesFrom). The richer DDI-CDI DescriptorVariable attributes (function, role, unit of measure, data type, etc.) are NOT part of the CDIF building block, so this is a curated 'new' class rather than a bare map of the source. From cdifDataType/cdifDescriptorVariable.
class.definition: cdi:DescriptorVariable - names the descriptor codes used in a long-format data structure; each code is paired (via the DescriptorValueDomain) with the RepresentedVariable it names.

attribute.name: name
attribute.definition: cdif:name - human-understandable name(s) of the descriptor variable.

class._comment: InstanceVariable is used by DataStructure components as well as by Discovery's variableMeasured. Included here for self-contained Data Structure UML.
ForeignKey - a key whose components reference the PrimaryKey of another DataStructure (cdi:ForeignKey).
ValueAndConceptDescription - description of the values/concepts a value domain admits (cdi:ValueAndConceptDescription): ranges, patterns, classification level, etc.
UnitType - the type of unit a (conceptual/represented) variable measures (cdi:UnitType).
PhysicalDataSet - byte-level realization of a dataset that a distribution is structured by (cdi:PhysicalDataSet). Subtypes: TabularTextDataSet, StructuredDataSet.

association._comment: Generic cdi:has at the DataStructure level: every data structure has 1..* DataStructureComponent (the abstract supertype). The concrete per-variant component requirements are the WideDataStructure_has_*/Long.../Dimensional... associations below; the variants generalize DataStructure so this generic association applies to all of them.
cdi:has PrimaryKey at the generic DataStructure level (any data structure can have one); variants inherit it via generalization.

cdif:isDefinedBy_RepresentedVariable - declared once on the abstract DataStructureComponent so every concrete component (IdentifierComponent, MeasureComponent, AttributeComponent, DimensionComponent, VariableValueComponent) inherits it. The DDI-CDI ReferenceVariable that defines a VariableValueComponent is just a RepresentedVariable in the CDIF schema. VariableDescriptorComponent is the exception (defined by a DescriptorVariable) and is modelled standalone, not as a DataStructureComponent.

cdif:isDefinedBy_DescriptorVariable - VariableDescriptorComponent (the descriptor column) is defined by a DescriptorVariable, not a RepresentedVariable, so it is modelled standalone (not generalizing DataStructureComponent) and carries its own isDefinedBy association.

cdi:refersTo - the descriptor column refers to the VariableValueComponent whose values its descriptor codes identify. Modelled as an @id object reference in JSON; the target type is also enforced by SHACL (cdifVariableDescriptorComponentShape). New association (CDIF-specific typing).
association.definition: cdi:refersTo - the VariableValueComponent in the same data structure whose values the descriptor codes identify.

association._comment: cdif:hasValuesFrom - the DescriptorValueDomain enumerating the codes the descriptor variable can take; each code is paired (via cdif:isDefinedBy) with the RepresentedVariable it names. New association (CDIF-specific; required on cdifDescriptorVariable).
association.definition: cdif:hasValuesFrom - the DescriptorValueDomain enumerating the codes that can appear in the descriptor column.

association._comment: Refined per audit_cdif_vs_ddi.py: cdi:takesSubstantiveValuesFrom in CDIF restricts the target type to SubstantiveValueDomain (rather than the bare ValueDomain DDI-CDI permits). Source association RepresentedVariable_takesSubstantiveValuesFrom_SubstantiveValueDomain already encodes this restriction in the source XMI - keep target identical.
Same audit note for cdi:takesSentinelValuesFrom (restricted to SentinelValueDomain in CDIF).
cdif:uses_Concept - the controlled-vocabulary skos:Concept(s) the RepresentedVariable represents/measures (akin to schema:propertyID). New association (CDIF-specific; no DDI-CDI source association).
association.definition: cdif:uses - the concept(s) this represented variable measures or represents, as references to skos:Concept entries.

association._comment: cdi:qualifies association on AttributeComponent. DDI-CDI has AttributeComponent_qualifies_DataStructureComponent; CDIF's DataStructure profile narrows the qualifies target to MeasureComponent per the cdifDataStructureComponent BB. Renamed accordingly.

cdi:isStructuredBy - the distribution carries it. In the instance the distribution object is co-typed schema:DataDownload + cdi:PhysicalDataSet; the association is anchored on DataDownload so it renders on the distribution class readers recognize. (A WebAPI carries it on its Action result instead - see ActionResult_isStructuredBy_DataStructure.) New association (DDI-CDI carries it on DataSet/PhysicalDataSet).
association.definition: cdi:isStructuredBy - the DataStructure describing this distribution's physical layout.

association._comment: cdi:isStructuredBy on a WebAPI Action result. The Action response (ActionResult) is the per-request representation a WebAPI distribution returns; its physical layout is described by a DataStructure, mirroring DataDownload_isStructuredBy_DataStructure. New association (ActionResult is defined in CDIFCore).
association.definition: cdi:isStructuredBy - the DataStructure describing the physical layout of this Action result representation.

association._comment: cdif:uses - the InstanceVariable references the RepresentedVariable it instantiates; the represented-variable-level properties live on the RepresentedVariable and are not duplicated on the InstanceVariable. The instance @id targets a RepresentedVariable. New association (no DDI-CDI source association from InstanceVariable).
association.definition: cdif:uses - the RepresentedVariable this InstanceVariable instantiates.

association._comment: cdi:measures - the unit type a represented variable measures. New association (DDI-CDI carries measures on ConceptualVariable).
association.definition: cdi:measures - the UnitType this represented variable measures.

association._comment: cdif:isDefinedBy - the enumeration domain is defined by a Concept. Mapped from the DDI-CDI source association.
